# Docker's apt repo (the `docker` archive, https://download.docker.com/linux/debian):
# the pinned engine the gen-2 slice guest images are customized with. Docker
# publishes no snapshot service, so warming at cut time is what keeps these
# exact versions downloadable forever.
#
# The engine and containerd pins are the ones libs/mngr_vps/.../host_setup.py
# installs (PINNED_DOCKER_APT_VERSION_CORE / PINNED_CONTAINERD_APT_VERSION_CORE
# with the trixie distro suffix); a test in minds_admin keeps them in step.
# The client-side plugins are unpinned there, so an unversioned entry here
# resolves to the newest version in the frozen index -- exactly what
# `apt-get install docker-buildx-plugin` picks against that index. The same
# goes for docker-ce-rootless-extras: docker-ce Recommends it (installed by
# default), and it carries no version tie to the engine, so apt takes the
# newest one in the index.
#
# Format: one entry per line, `name` or `name=version`; `#` starts a comment.
docker-ce=5:29.6.2-1~debian.13~trixie
docker-ce-cli=5:29.6.2-1~debian.13~trixie
containerd.io=2.2.6-1~debian.13~trixie
docker-buildx-plugin
docker-compose-plugin
docker-ce-rootless-extras
